title: Europe in 1975 with Panama Francis, Roy Gaines and Milt Buckner
summary: He toured Europe for six months with Panama Francis, Roy Gaines and Buckner, and had known Panama from Lucky Millinder's band.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Just thinking of that trip to Europe quickly, you were with Panama Francis?
Ah, it was Panama and Roy Gaines, Milt Buckner and myself. Yeah. It was four of us.
Had you played with Panama in New York?
Oh, when I was with Lucky Millender we worked together. And then I did a thing at the Strand Theater when he was in the band, with Cab, yeah.
O.K., so was it with Jimmy Rochelle...you had been with him and then you went into Kelly Martin's Band?
Yes, I think it was. I went to Detroit after that, yeah.
